newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Northeast Electrical details A dividend.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Electrical details A dividend.

text.p: China's Northeast Electrical Transmission & Transformation Machinery Manufacturing Co Ltd on Wednesday said it will pay a cash dividend of 0.065 yuan per A share based on 1996 profits.

The dividend registration deadline is June 20 and Northeast Electrical's Shenzhen-listed domestic A shares, will go ex-dividend on June 23, said a company statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company, China's largest high-voltage transmission equipment and transformer maker, also has H shares -- equity issued by mainland firms and listed in Hong Kong.
Northeast did not mention a dividend for holders of the firm's H shares. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.

The company posted a net profit of 83.77 million yuan for 1996 against 163.45 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards. It blamed the setback on weak demand and lower sale prices.
